text.arabic_uthmani: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ إِن جَآءَكُمْ فَاسِقٌۢ بِنَبَإٍۢ فَتَبَيَّنُوٓا۟ أَن تُصِيبُوا۟ قَوْمًۢا بِجَهَٰلَةٍۢ فَتُصْبِحُوا۟ عَلَىٰ مَا فَعَلْتُمْ نَٰدِمِينَ

words.gloss_range: opening vocative particle that summons the audience into direct responsibility before the conditional case begins
words.prose: {{ar:يَا}} ({{tr:yā}}) opens the ayah as a direct summons before any report or risk is described. Its payoff is that verification is heard first as an obligation placed on the listeners, not as detached advice about someone else. The lengthened call and boundary from 49:5 also reset the discourse from a prior scene into a new communal procedure for handling information.

topics.headline: vocative summons before condition
topics.summary: The reader notices that the ayah begins by making the audience answerable before the risk scenario appears.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah begins by making the audience answerable before the risk scenario appears.
topics.reason: The particle opens formal address and fixes the later command inside direct communal responsibility.

topics.headline: boundary reset into information governance
topics.summary: The reader notices the shift from the prior ayah into a new legal-address frame for report evaluation.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the shift from the prior ayah into a new legal-address frame for report evaluation.
topics.reason: Boundary and sound rows show the opening call as a fresh discourse launch, with 49:5 behind it.

words.gloss_range: vocative mediator in the fixed address formula, not an interrogative which-question
words.prose: {{ar:أَيُّ}} ({{tr:ʾayyu}}) is the hinge inside the formal call. It does not ask a question; it delays and mediates the addressee until the following belief-description can define who is being summoned. That makes the opening feel ceremonial and juridical: the community is named through its qualification before the command arrives.

topics.headline: vocative mediator not question
topics.summary: The reader notices that the form hails the audience rather than asking which audience is meant.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the form hails the audience rather than asking which audience is meant.
topics.reason: The fixed formula with the surrounding call and relative phrase blocks an interrogative parse.

topics.headline: delayed addressee definition
topics.summary: The reader notices that the addressee is held open until the believing class is fully named.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the addressee is held open until the believing class is fully named.
topics.reason: The mediator turns the prior third-person scene into direct class address.

words.gloss_range: definite relative pronoun that defines the summoned class by the belief clause following it
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلَّذِينَ}} ({{tr:alladhīna}}) makes the audience grammatically definite through a relative clause. The command will not address an undefined crowd; it reaches the people under the description of having believed. This also routes the same group forward as verifiers, possible actors, and possible regretters, so accountability is continuous across the ayah.

topics.headline: definite relative addressee
topics.summary: The reader notices that the audience is defined by the following belief clause, not left as a loose crowd.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the audience is defined by the following belief clause, not left as a loose crowd.
topics.reason: The relative form requires its clause and fuses the command audience with the belief-description.

topics.headline: same group carried forward
topics.summary: The reader notices that the opening audience remains the responsible subject through verification, action, and regret.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the opening audience remains the responsible subject through verification, action, and regret.
topics.reason: Referent-routing rows make the later plural verbs accountable to the initial addressee class.

words.gloss_range: perfect Form IV plural belief-status; locally an established trust identity that grounds the verification command
words.root_gloss_range: root range of belief, trust, security, and entrusting; the local Form IV selects entered faith and trust-bearing status
words.prose: {{ar:ءَامَنُوٓا۟}} ({{tr:āmanū}}) names the addressees as already having entered a trust-bearing status. The root {{ar:أ م ن}} ({{tr:ʾ-m-n}}) keeps belief, trust, and security close to the command, so careless reception of a report would violate the identity by which the audience is addressed. The payoff is structural as well: completed trust precedes the imperative to verify, and the surah later tests belief-language again, so verification becomes a procedure demanded by faith rather than an optional caution.

topics.headline: completed trust status
topics.summary: The reader notices that the command addresses people as already trust-bound, not as people first being invited into belief.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the command addresses people as already trust-bound, not as people first being invited into belief.
topics.reason: Perfect Form IV and plural agreement define the addressees by completed communal status.

topics.headline: belief trust and security field
topics.summary: The reader notices that the belief verb carries trust and security pressure, while the local sense remains the believers address formula.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the belief verb carries trust and security pressure, while the local sense remains the believers address formula.
topics.reason: Root-family evidence supports trust and security resonance without replacing the local faith-status sense.

topics.headline: trust identity drives verification
topics.summary: The reader notices that verification is downstream from the audience identity and participates in the surah-wide belief test, including 49:14.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that verification is downstream from the audience identity and participates in the surah-wide belief test, including 49:14.
topics.reason: Sequence, same-surah, and inter-ayah rows connect the belief address to the later clarity command and belief-correction scenes.

words.gloss_range: conditional particle marking a possible report-event and making the imperative its required answer
words.prose: {{ar:إِنْ}} ({{tr:in}}) opens a genuine conditional, so the ayah legislates for a possible source failure without treating it as inevitable. The particle suspends the scene until the verification command answers it; if the compromised report arrives, the response is not optional. This keeps uncertainty and obligation together: the case may or may not occur, but its procedure is fixed.

topics.headline: possible event not expected occurrence
topics.summary: The reader notices that the scenario is regulated as possible risk rather than presumed normal behavior.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the scenario is regulated as possible risk rather than presumed normal behavior.
topics.reason: The conditional particle marks uncertainty while still setting up a binding response.

topics.headline: conditional imperative architecture
topics.summary: The reader notices that the later imperative is the grammatical answer to the risk, not a free-standing recommendation.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the later imperative is the grammatical answer to the risk, not a free-standing recommendation.
topics.reason: Rows on protasis, apodosis, and legal architecture show the condition waiting for the command.

words.gloss_range: perfect arrival verb with attached second-person plural recipients; locally the triggering arrival of a bearer with content
words.root_gloss_range: root range of coming, arriving, and occurrence; the local construction selects completed arrival to the addressed community with report-bearing force
words.prose: {{ar:جَآءَكُمْ}} ({{tr:jāʾakum}}) makes the community the direct recipients of the event through the attached plural suffix. The root {{ar:ج ي أ}} ({{tr:j-y-ʾ}}) is locally narrowed to completed arrival in a conditional trigger, but the construction is not bare motion: subject, recipients, and report-bearing complement form an information-transfer frame. The payoff is that misinformation is not observed from outside; it comes to the addressed group and activates their duty.

topics.headline: recipient-attached arrival
topics.summary: The reader notices that the report reaches the addressed community directly, making them responsible recipients.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the report reaches the addressed community directly, making them responsible recipients.
topics.reason: The suffix and perfect conditional form make arrival a completed trigger for the addressees.

topics.headline: arrival as report delivery
topics.summary: The reader notices that coming is narrowed by the report complement into delivery of information, not just movement.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that coming is narrowed by the report complement into delivery of information, not just movement.
topics.reason: Root and construction evidence support arrival or occurrence, while local syntax selects bearer-with-content delivery.

topics.headline: suspect arrival reverses prior movement
topics.summary: The reader notices the boundary reversal from desired approach in 49:5 to a suspect source coming to the community in 49:6.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the boundary reversal from desired approach in 49:5 to a suspect source coming to the community in 49:6.
topics.reason: Boundary and report-arrival rows make the motion direction and credibility tension visible.

words.gloss_range: indefinite active participle naming a boundary-breaching source as the arriving subject
words.root_gloss_range: root range of exiting, breach, and moral deviation; locally it marks compromised source integrity without naming a fixed individual
words.prose: {{ar:فَاسِقٌ}} ({{tr:fāsiqun}}) places source integrity before report content. As an indefinite active participle, it generalizes the rule to any compromised bearer rather than one named person, while the root {{ar:ف س ق}} ({{tr:f-s-q}}) gives the label a boundary-breach image. The source and report are both indefinite, so the ayah builds a repeatable verification protocol: when a breach-marked source carries consequential information, trust-holders must test it before acting.

topics.headline: indefinite arriving subject
topics.summary: The reader notices that any compromised bearer can trigger the protocol, not only one historical individual.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that any compromised bearer can trigger the protocol, not only one historical individual.
topics.reason: Nominative participle and tanwīn make the suspect source the generalized subject of arrival.

topics.headline: boundary breach source label
topics.summary: The reader notices source unreliability as a breach of communal boundaries, while the local role remains source credibility.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices source unreliability as a breach of communal boundaries, while the local role remains source credibility.
topics.reason: Root imagery of exit and breach colors the participle without turning it into a literal physical emergence.

topics.headline: source before content testing
topics.summary: The reader notices that the ayah inspects source status before the report and later internalizes breach-language in 49:7 and 49:11.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah inspects source status before the report and later internalizes breach-language in 49:7 and 49:11.
topics.reason: Order, pairing, same-surah, and cadence rows connect source, report, and community danger.

words.gloss_range: preposition attached to the report noun, marking the content carried with the arriving source
words.prose: {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi}}) turns arrival into delivery. The bearer does not merely come; he comes with consequential content, and the small bound preposition makes that content dependent on the arrival event. Its later echo before ignorance also matters: the ayah moves from report carried with a source to harm performed in or because of ignorance.

topics.headline: content-bearing preposition
topics.summary: The reader notices that the scene is information transfer, not bare arrival.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the scene is information transfer, not bare arrival.
topics.reason: The preposition governs the report noun and attaches it to the coming event.

topics.headline: two prepositions frame the arc
topics.summary: The reader notices the movement from information brought with a source to action occurring in ignorance.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the movement from information brought with a source to action occurring in ignorance.
topics.reason: Repeated-preposition rows connect this word with the later preposition before ignorance.

words.gloss_range: indefinite genitive report noun; locally weighty consequential information carried by a suspect source
words.root_gloss_range: root range of informing, news, announcement, and weighty report; the local noun selects consequential report rather than ordinary chatter
words.prose: {{ar:نَبَإٍ}} ({{tr:nabaʾin}}) is not just any chatter. Its indefinite form generalizes the ruling to any consequential report, and the root {{ar:ن ب أ}} ({{tr:n-b-ʾ}}) gives the information announcement-weight. That gravity creates the tension: serious information is arriving through a compromised channel, so the content becomes precisely the kind of thing that must be clarified before it drives action.

topics.headline: indefinite governed report
topics.summary: The reader notices that the rule covers any consequential report carried in this construction.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the rule covers any consequential report carried in this construction.
topics.reason: Genitive case and tanwīn mark the report as governed content and generalized trigger.

topics.headline: weighty announcement register
topics.summary: The reader notices the noun carries consequential report-weight, while local usage remains report content rather than prophetic authority.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the noun carries consequential report-weight, while local usage remains report content rather than prophetic authority.
topics.reason: Root-family and nabaʾ-versus-khabar evidence support gravity without overreading the bearer as authoritative.

topics.headline: serious report through compromised bearer
topics.summary: The reader notices that the danger is the combination of weighty content and unreliable source.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the danger is the combination of weighty content and unreliable source.
topics.reason: Pairing and announcement-field rows connect the report noun to verification and source credibility.

words.gloss_range: response particle that binds the conditional risk to the immediate verification command
words.prose: {{ar:فَ}} ({{tr:fa}}) is the hinge from risk to commanded response. It answers the conditional and binds the verification imperative to the arrival of the suspect report, so the command is not an afterthought. The same particle later marks harmful consequence, letting the ayah contrast two chains: verify as the required response, or fail and arrive at regret.

topics.headline: conditional answer particle
topics.summary: The reader notices that verification is the immediate grammatical answer to the report-event.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that verification is the immediate grammatical answer to the report-event.
topics.reason: The particle functions as the apodosis marker and is fused to the command.

topics.headline: prevention and consequence split
topics.summary: The reader notices that repeated response particles map opposite routes: prevention here and regret later.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that repeated response particles map opposite routes: prevention here and regret later.
topics.reason: Comparison rows distinguish this answer-particle from the later consequence particle.

words.gloss_range: plural Form V imperative: make the matter clear for yourselves in response to the conditional report
words.root_gloss_range: root range of separation, between-ness, clarity, and making evident; local Form V selects reflexive verification and distinction
words.prose: {{ar:تَبَيَّنُوٓا۟}} ({{tr:tabayyanū}}) compresses the whole required response into one plural imperative. The root {{ar:ب ي ن}} ({{tr:b-y-n}}) makes verification an act of separating and distinguishing, and Form V makes the community produce clarity for itself rather than passively accept the source. The accepted variant reading adds firmness as a second face of the same discipline, but the local surface keeps clarity and distinction in front: trust-holders must make the report clear before action.

topics.headline: reflexive plural imperative
topics.summary: The reader notices that the recipients themselves must produce clarity, not wait for the compromised bearer to explain.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the recipients themselves must produce clarity, not wait for the compromised bearer to explain.
topics.reason: Form V, imperative force, and plural ending bind verification agency to the addressed community.

topics.headline: clarity and firmness discipline
topics.summary: The reader notices the selected clarity-root and the accepted firmness variant as paired epistemic disciplines, while the local surface remains clarity.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the selected clarity-root and the accepted firmness variant as paired epistemic disciplines, while the local surface remains clarity.
topics.reason: Root evidence and canonical variant evidence are retained, with the variant narrowing rather than replacing the local reading.

topics.headline: one-word apodosis urgency
topics.summary: The reader notices that a long risk condition receives a compact command, making the response swift and procedural.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that a long risk condition receives a compact command, making the response swift and procedural.
topics.reason: Structural rows show the single imperative as the compressed answer to the conditional.

words.gloss_range: subjunctive purpose-warning particle with preventive force, opening the harm-to-regret scope
words.prose: {{ar:أَنْ}} ({{tr:an}}) opens the clause that verification is meant to prevent. Though formally positive, it carries the force of a warning: do not let the unverified report lead you into striking a people and then regretting the deed. Its scope stretches beyond the first harm verb to the final regret, so prevention covers the whole causal chain.

topics.headline: positive particle with preventive force
topics.summary: The reader notices that the grammar names a possible action in order to avert it.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the grammar names a possible action in order to avert it.
topics.reason: The particle is formally a subjunctive marker, while local purpose and caution evidence narrow its force to lest/prevention.

topics.headline: scope from harm to regret
topics.summary: The reader notices that verification prevents not only the strike but the whole sequence ending in remorse.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that verification prevents not only the strike but the whole sequence ending in remorse.
topics.reason: Scope rows extend the warning clause from the harm verb through the final regret predicate.

words.gloss_range: subjunctive Form IV plural verb warning against a preventable transitive strike on a people
words.root_gloss_range: root range of hitting the mark, correctness, impact, descent, and affliction; local Form IV selects transitive harmful impact
words.prose: {{ar:تُصِيبُوا۟}} ({{tr:tuṣībū}}) is the pivot where bad information could become concrete harm. Its subjunctive form keeps the strike preventable, while Form IV and the direct object make the addressed community potential agents of impact on a people. The root {{ar:ص و ب}} ({{tr:ṣ-w-b}}) adds the sharp irony that one may think one is hitting the mark, yet the unverified action becomes an affliction that lands on others.

topics.headline: preventable transitive harm
topics.summary: The reader notices that the warned harm is future and avoidable, but if it happens it lands on a concrete collective.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the warned harm is future and avoidable, but if it happens it lands on a concrete collective.
topics.reason: Subjunctive mood, Form IV transitivity, and plural subject keep preventability and agency visible.

topics.headline: hitting-mark and affliction irony
topics.summary: The reader notices the root tension between correctness and impact, while local syntax selects harmful striking rather than abstract rightness.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the root tension between correctness and impact, while local syntax selects harmful striking rather than abstract rightness.
topics.reason: Root-family evidence supports correctness, descent, and calamity resonance without displacing the local transitive warning.

topics.headline: sound and chain toward regret
topics.summary: The reader notices that this harm verb begins the consequence cascade and even sounds linked to the later becoming-regret verb.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that this harm verb begins the consequence cascade and even sounds linked to the later becoming-regret verb.
topics.reason: Structural and phonetic rows connect the strike to the later result verb and regret state.

words.gloss_range: indefinite accusative collective object: any people who could be harmed by unverified action
words.root_gloss_range: root range of standing, establishing, peoplehood, value, and uprightness; locally it selects a social collective as the affected target
words.prose: {{ar:قَوْمًۢا}} ({{tr:qawman}}) gives the potential harm a social body. The accusative case makes the people the object struck, and the indefinite collective form means any group can be the victim, not merely a named party. The root {{ar:ق و م}} ({{tr:q-w-m}}) keeps standing, collectivity, and worth in the background, so the warning is not about a private mistake but about damaging a community that stands as one body.

topics.headline: indefinite collective object
topics.summary: The reader notices that the victim is any collective people, made the direct object of possible harm.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the victim is any collective people, made the direct object of possible harm.
topics.reason: Accusative case, tanwīn, and collective noun form identify the generalized target.

topics.headline: standing social body
topics.summary: The reader notices that the people are imagined as a standing collective with worth, while the local sense remains an affected group.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the people are imagined as a standing collective with worth, while the local sense remains an affected group.
topics.reason: Root-family evidence supports standing and value resonance without replacing the ordinary people noun.

topics.headline: victim before ignorance
topics.summary: The reader notices that the ayah names the harmed people before naming the ignorance that causes the harm.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah names the harmed people before naming the ignorance that causes the harm.
topics.reason: Order and same-surah rows foreground the victim before the epistemic condition.

words.gloss_range: preposition governing ignorance as the manner and cause of the possible strike
words.prose: {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi}}) attaches ignorance directly to the harm clause. Its payoff is double: the strike happens in a state of ignorance and because of ignorance. The earlier report-bearing preposition is now inverted; information came with a source, but action may proceed in the medium that verification was supposed to remove.

topics.headline: ignorance as cause and manner
topics.summary: The reader notices that ignorance is both the condition of action and the reason it goes wrong.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that ignorance is both the condition of action and the reason it goes wrong.
topics.reason: The governed genitive construction permits causal and circumstantial force together.

topics.headline: prepositional inversion of report into ignorance
topics.summary: The reader notices that the repeated preposition maps the ayah from information-with-source to harm-in-ignorance.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the repeated preposition maps the ayah from information-with-source to harm-in-ignorance.
topics.reason: Rows comparing the two prepositions show the epistemological arc and inversion.

words.gloss_range: indefinite gerund naming ignorance as the operative condition and cause behind harmful action
words.root_gloss_range: root range of not-knowing, rash conduct, culpable disregard, and ignorance-regime; locally it selects the ignorance condition that verification must prevent
words.prose: {{ar:جَهَٰلَةٍ}} ({{tr:jahālatin}}) names the epistemic failure that turns a report into harm. It is more than missing information: the root {{ar:ج ه ل}} ({{tr:j-h-l}}) includes rash conduct and culpable disregard, while the verbal noun makes ignorance an operative condition rather than a permanent label on the actors. Sitting between strike and regret, it becomes the hinge that verification is meant to remove.

topics.headline: ignorance as process condition
topics.summary: The reader notices that ignorance is named as a governing condition of action, not as a fixed identity label.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that ignorance is named as a governing condition of action, not as a fixed identity label.
topics.reason: Gerund form, genitive government, and tanwīn make ignorance an open operative state.

topics.headline: not-knowing plus rash conduct
topics.summary: The reader notices that ignorance includes reckless acting on not-knowing, while local usage need not claim deliberate pretense.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that ignorance includes reckless acting on not-knowing, while local usage need not claim deliberate pretense.
topics.reason: Root-family evidence supports rashness and wider ignorance fields, narrowed away from overclaiming feigned ignorance.

topics.headline: hinge between harm and remorse
topics.summary: The reader notices that ignorance sits at the structural pivot from striking people to becoming regretful.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that ignorance sits at the structural pivot from striking people to becoming regretful.
topics.reason: Position and synthesis rows make the clarity-versus-ignorance axis central to the ayah.

words.gloss_range: consequence particle linking the possible strike to the aftermath of becoming regretful
words.prose: {{ar:فَ}} ({{tr:fa}}) before the becoming verb marks aftermath, not the earlier conditional answer. It keeps harm and regret sequentially connected: after striking through ignorance, the community consequently becomes regretful. The repeated particle chain lets the ayah contrast the required verification path with the preventable regret path.

topics.headline: sequential consequence particle
topics.summary: The reader notices that regret follows the strike as consequence rather than merely describing it.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that regret follows the strike as consequence rather than merely describing it.
topics.reason: The particle links the harm clause to the aftermath verb with sequence and causation.

topics.headline: paired particles map two chains
topics.summary: The reader notices that repeated particles divide the ayah into command-response and harm-consequence routes.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that repeated particles divide the ayah into command-response and harm-consequence routes.
topics.reason: Rows on the paired and three-part particle chain show prevention versus cascade.

words.gloss_range: subjunctive Form IV becoming verb that requires the final regret predicate
words.root_gloss_range: root range of morning, becoming, dawning, and resultative state; locally it functions as an incomplete verb completed by regret
words.prose: {{ar:تُصْبِحُوا۟}} ({{tr:tuṣbiḥū}}) begins the final state but cannot complete it alone. Grammatically it is an incomplete becoming verb that needs the regret predicate, and the root {{ar:ص ب ح}} ({{tr:ṣ-b-ḥ}}) lets regret feel like a dawned disclosure after action. The payoff is painful timing: awareness comes as a collective state after the strike, when clarity is too late.

topics.headline: incomplete becoming verb
topics.summary: The reader notices that the verb holds the subject open until regret fills the final state.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the verb holds the subject open until regret fills the final state.
topics.reason: Valency and predicate rows show the verb requiring the final active participle.

topics.headline: dawned disclosure of regret
topics.summary: The reader notices morning/becoming imagery in the result state, while local syntax selects becoming regretful.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices morning/becoming imagery in the result state, while local syntax selects becoming regretful.
topics.reason: Root-family evidence supports dawn and light resonance without turning the clause into literal morning.

topics.headline: formulaic path to regret
topics.summary: The reader notices that the strike verb and becoming-regret verb are linked by sound, formula, and causal order.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the strike verb and becoming-regret verb are linked by sound, formula, and causal order.
topics.reason: Pairing, formula, and phonetic rows connect this verb to the final regret predicate.

words.gloss_range: preposition attaching regret to the deed as what it bears upon
words.prose: {{ar:عَلَىٰ}} ({{tr:ʿalā}}) prevents the final remorse from floating without an object. It routes regret onto what the community did, making the past action feel like a weight borne by the actors. The compact prepositional phrase gathers the whole prior harm-chain under the object of regret.

topics.headline: regret over a deed
topics.summary: The reader notices exactly what regret bears upon: the community's own action.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices exactly what regret bears upon: the community's own action.
topics.reason: The preposition governs the relative deed phrase and specifies regret's object.

topics.headline: uponness as burden
topics.summary: The reader notices the spatial pressure of over/upon as burden, while the local meaning remains regret over the deed.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the spatial pressure of over/upon as burden, while the local meaning remains regret over the deed.
topics.reason: Prepositional range supports burden imagery without changing the grammatical complement relation.

words.gloss_range: relative pronoun gathering the deed-complex as the object over which regret occurs
words.prose: {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:mā}}) is relative here, not a question. It gathers the preceding action-complex into a broad object of regret: what you did. Because it does not name a narrow act, the remorse can cover the whole chain produced by unverified information, including decision, implementation, and harm.

topics.headline: relative not interrogative
topics.summary: The reader notices that the phrase identifies regret's object rather than asking about it.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the phrase identifies regret's object rather than asking about it.
topics.reason: Position after the preposition and before the verb resolves the surface as relative.

topics.headline: broad deed-complex gathered
topics.summary: The reader notices that regret covers the whole enacted harm-chain, not a single isolated detail.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that regret covers the whole enacted harm-chain, not a single isolated detail.
topics.reason: Rows on open relative scope and embedded action show the broad object of remorse.

words.gloss_range: perfect second-person plural doing verb; locally the completed deed viewed from future regret
words.root_gloss_range: root range of doing, acting, and paradigmatic action; locally it keeps the regretted deed broad and completed
words.prose: {{ar:فَعَلْتُمْ}} ({{tr:faʿaltum}}) makes the future warning look back on an already completed deed. The second-person plural ending binds the actors to the same audience commanded to verify, and the root {{ar:ف ع ل}} ({{tr:f-ʿ-l}}) keeps the deed category maximally broad. Regret is therefore not limited to what they said or thought; it lands on the whole action they carried out after failing to verify.

topics.headline: completed deed by same addressees
topics.summary: The reader notices that the warned community is projected into hindsight over its own finished action.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the warned community is projected into hindsight over its own finished action.
topics.reason: Perfect tense and second-person plural suffix bind completion and agency to the addressees.

topics.headline: maximally broad doing
topics.summary: The reader notices that the object of regret is any enacted deed, not only speech, judgment, or intention.

words.gloss_range: plural active participle predicate naming the community as regretful after the completed deed
words.root_gloss_range: root range of regret, remorse, and post-action anguish; locally it selects the settled state that verification prevents
words.prose: {{ar:نَٰدِمِينَ}} ({{tr:nādimīna}}) is the final predicate and terminal state of the ayah. As a plural active participle, it makes regret a condition the same community inhabits, not an outside judgment. The root {{ar:ن د م}} ({{tr:n-d-m}}) carries post-action remorse, and the becoming-regret formula recalls the Cain scene in 5:31; the ayah ends not with the harm itself but with preventable collective remorse after the deed is done.

topics.headline: plural predicate of becoming
topics.summary: The reader notices that regret becomes the community's own state at the end of the clause.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that regret becomes the community's own state at the end of the clause.
topics.reason: Accusative plural participle agreement makes the final word the predicate of the becoming verb.

topics.headline: felt post-action remorse

topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices regret as embodied post-action remorse, while local usage remains the active participle state.
topics.reason: Root and rarity evidence support marked remorse without adding a new event beyond the completed deed.

topics.headline: terminal regret formula

baseline_models.focus_anchor: 49:6 words 3, 5-8, 10-13, and 16-17 form an arrival-to-action causal chain addressed to people defined by trusting assent.
baseline_models.mechanism: A community grounded in trusting assent receives a consequential report through a transmitter marked by boundary-emergence. Clarification must make distinctions visible before the report becomes an aimed impact on a collective; otherwise unsettled ignorance becomes deed, a new state, and remorse.

activation_trace.role: Trusting assent and confirmation supply the addressees' epistemic commitment and make unexamined uptake internally contradictory.
A date leaving its peel supplies boundary-emergence and marks the transmission channel as having crossed its enclosure.
Consequential reported news supplies the object whose knowledge-producing force must be tested.
Appearance and clarification supply the required conversion from assertion to visible distinction.
Aiming and reaching a target make acceptance of the report the start of an action trajectory.
A human group supplies the collective body exposed to the trajectory rather than an abstract error cost.
Rash unsettled folly supplies the kinetic condition in which deficient knowledge turns quickly into harm.
Becoming a state supplies the irreversible-looking transition from event to lived remorse.
Bringing an act into being locates responsibility in what the receivers actually cause.
Remorse over a past matter supplies delayed recognition after the preventable act is fixed.

changed_reading.before: Check an unreliable person's report before accidentally harming people.
changed_reading.after: Trusted assent requires an epistemic interlock: turn an incoming consequential claim into visible distinctions before it acquires aim, strikes a collective, and hardens into a remorseful state.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: 49:6 words 7-12 place report, clarification, impact, collective, and ignorance in immediate sequence.
baseline_models.mechanism: The report can be carried as a moving projectile rather than static content. It may swerve, clarification opens an inspectable interval and path, impact reaches a standing social body, and ignorance is unmarked terrain; verification therefore corrects course as well as deciding truth.

activation_trace.role: A shot swerving away from its cut supplies the report's capacity to deviate while still traveling.
A clear path and easy ground supply the route a corrected report should disclose.
The interval between things supplies diagnostic distance between reception and response.
Visible clarification makes the trajectory and its divergence inspectable.
Targeting and hitting supply the endpoint toward which accepted information can propel action.
Upright standing supplies the exposed social body at the trajectory's endpoint.
Unknown unmarked terrain supplies navigation without reliable signs.
A remaining trace or mark supplies the residue left after the misdirected strike.

changed_reading.before: Verification asks whether a proposition is true or false.
changed_reading.after: Verification also inspects the report's path: origin, drift, route, target, and likely residue before receivers let it move their bodies.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: 49:6 words 5-8 bring an outside report through a boundary-marked transmitter into a command of separation and disclosure; word 11 names the affected collective.
baseline_models.mechanism: The verse models information crossing a social membrane. Arrival presents material from elsewhere, the transmitter's branch image signals emergence outside an enclosure, and clarification separates while preserving the relation between parties. The protected object is the group's maintained standing, not merely factual accuracy.

activation_trace.role: Bringing or presenting something supplies the transfer of informational material into the community.
Emergence from a peel supplies a vivid breached-envelope condition without making it a permanent essence.
Separation supplies discrimination between report, reporter, inference, and response.
The tie between parties supplies the relation that careful discrimination must preserve.
Care, guardianship, and preservation make the collective's maintained life the object at risk.
Social support and subsistence supply what a false impact can destabilize.
Retrospective remorse registers failure of the membrane only after relational damage occurs.

changed_reading.before: The morally suspect messenger is the problem, and fact-checking filters his content.
changed_reading.after: The verse treats every boundary-crossing transmission as a membrane event: discriminate its parts while guarding the connective tissue and standing of the receiving and targeted groups.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: 49:6 joins clarification, impact in ignorance, becoming, deed, and remorse with a tightly linked sequence of particles.
baseline_models.mechanism: Ignorance is not only missing data but agitated loss of composure. Impact then becomes an affliction, the receivers bring an act into being, and awareness arrives retrospectively as remorse and residue. Clarification functions as a temporal brake inserted before momentum becomes state.

activation_trace.role: Time during an unfolding action supplies a narrow intervention interval inside the causal sequence.
An affliction that lands on a person supplies the human cost of the unchecked impact.
Agitation after stillness supplies the acceleration by which uncertainty becomes impulsive action.
Coming to be in a state supplies the delayed experiential result of the act.
Causing an act to exist assigns the irreversible middle step to the receivers.
Remorse over what is past supplies cognition that arrives too late.
A remaining mark supplies the durable aftermath that regret cannot erase.

changed_reading.before: Clarification improves confidence before a decision.
changed_reading.after: Clarification is a timing intervention: it arrests agitation during the small interval before reception becomes impact, deed, state, and ineradicable residue.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening prohibition on advancing, its marked interval, and the position before an authority pair turn focus verification into procedural non-preemption. An incoming report must not let receivers step past the ordering source before clarification has made the matter visible.

activation_trace.role: Forward advance and precedence supply the procedural motion that must be withheld.
An interval between parties supplies ordered space in which premature action would intrude.
The fixed before-the-hands relation supplies the authority-facing position that action must not outrun.
Focus clarification supplies the gate that ends the waiting interval legitimately.

structural_cues: 49:1 places a negative command before an advance; 49:6 places a positive clarification command before impact.
The repeated addressee formula makes the two procedural orders operate on the same receiving community.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies advance, interval, authority-position, and the focus causal order. I infer that clarification enforces procedural priority. A live alternative is that 49:1 concerns only decorum and does not specify report handling.

changed_reading.before: Pause long enough to check a dubious report.
changed_reading.after: Do not let a report preempt the community's legitimate ordering process; clarification is the gate that authorizes movement rather than a detached accuracy check.

context_deltas.mechanism: The voice sequence makes information a signal whose volume, broadcast, and reception can overwhelm fine awareness. Lowering the signal is followed by testing and refinement of the inner core. This revises focus clarification into gain control plus assay: reduce social amplitude, then test what remains before a faint or uncertain report becomes action.

activation_trace.role: Broadcasting a report supplies dissemination pressure, not merely physical loudness.
Audible sound supplies the channel whose amplitude can be mistaken for authority.
A wound relapsing while leaving a trace supplies hidden damage that persists after noisy conduct.
Fine perception supplies the sensitivity that excessive amplitude disables.
Restraint by lowering and reducing supplies signal attenuation before judgment.
A test that exposes what lies in the heart supplies the assay stage.
Refinement after testing supplies purification of the surviving signal.
The pure core of a thing supplies what the assay seeks beneath presentation.
A faint uncertain sound makes the focus report especially vulnerable to amplification and distortion.
Disclosure through expression or sign supplies the recovered signal after assay.

structural_cues: 49:2 links elevated vocal conduct to consequences that actors do not perceive.
49:3 reverses elevation into lowering and immediately pairs that restraint with a test of inner reliability.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies broadcast, audible signal, unnoticed damage, attenuation, testing, and refinement. I infer a signal-processing arrow from lowered amplitude to better assay. A live alternative is that these are etiquette and moral-testing images with no epistemic channel claim.

changed_reading.before: Compare the report with external facts.
changed_reading.after: First prevent loudness and circulation from manufacturing credibility, then assay the report's inner core; clarification is social gain control as well as evidence comparison.

context_deltas.mechanism: Calls arrive loudly from behind an enclosure, while reason is lexicalized as restraint against ignorance; the next movement is patient waiting until the concealed source comes out. This spatial reversal changes focus arrival: when attribution is barrier-obscured, receivers should create conditions for source and context to emerge rather than answer the loud proxy.

activation_trace.role: Raised calling supplies a salient but potentially low-context signal.
Concealment behind a back-facing boundary supplies obscured source conditions.
Prevention and enclosure supply the barrier across which the call loses context.
Reason as restraint from ignorance supplies the cognitive brake demanded by the barrier.
Holding oneself against agitation supplies the waiting operation.
Bringing something out of concealment supplies the proper resolution of source opacity.
Presentation on arrival anchors the context's reversed source-path in the focus report event.
Making the matter visible supplies the endpoint of patient emergence.

structural_cues: 49:4 positions callers on one side of an enclosure and the addressed person on the other.
49:5 explicitly delays response until outward emergence, reversing the direction of the arrival in 49:6.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies loud calling, concealment, enclosure, restraint, waiting, and emergence. I infer that barrier-obscured attribution degrades a report and that waiting can repair it. A live alternative is a purely interpersonal lesson about patience at a residence.

strongest_changes: Clarification became a procedural non-preemption gate and a temporal brake, not merely a truth check.
The voice, enclosure, patience, and emergence sequence turned verification into signal attenuation followed by waiting for source context to become visible.
Conflict, brotherhood, and balance made verification preventive peacemaking that protects a tethered social body.

Closing knowledge cues bounded the task: inspect motive and obtain warranted visibility without claiming exhaustive access to what remains hidden.
summary.what_was_special: The focus roots formed unusually coherent material mechanisms across domains: report as trajectory, clarification as interval and membrane, ignorance as agitation or unmarked terrain, action as state transition, and remorse as residue. Context did not collapse these into one reading; it added procedural, acoustic, spatial, governmental, relational, ethical, and epistemic controls while the split-root inventories preserved contained strange alternatives.
remaining_uncertainties: The peel-emergence branch strongly animates boundary crossing but may color the active transmitter descriptor more than its focus morphology permits.
The projectile, dawn-raid, wound, and paternalized-hostility models are mechanistically coherent yet branch-distant and should remain explicitly exploratory.
The anti-label and anti-surveillance constraints depend on reading later imperatives as limits on the method of focus clarification rather than adjacent independent rules.
The recognition reversal is strong at the sequence level, but the exact relation between a generic focus collective and the later differentiated human groupings remains open.
Finite verification can justify action under residual uncertainty, but the packet does not specify an operational threshold for sufficient clarification.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Check both the report's source and its trajectory.** ف س ق B002 pictures a date emerging from its peel; ن ب ء B005 is a shot that swerves without cutting and B006 a faint uncertain sound; ب ي ن B004 is becoming clear. The packet supplies an emerged carrier, a report, and verification. I infer that emergence from a boundary does not guarantee a straight informational flight. *Tabayyun* becomes trajectory-testing, not mere reception.
2. **An aimed act can become an affliction to a social body.** ص و ب B003 (aiming and hitting) and B004 (an affliction that hits) coexist in *tuṣībū*, while ق و م B004 supplies care and guardianship alongside "people" (B001). The packet gives the possible hit and its communal object; I infer that action taken as targeted correction can strike the very body one is charged to preserve. Verification interrupts that reversal.
3. **Rash motion hardens into a later trace.** ج ه ل B002 (rash unsettled folly) and B005 (agitating motion after stillness) lead to ص ب ح B010 (becoming in a state) and ن د م B003 (a remaining trace or mark), alongside direct remorse B001. The explicit sequence moves from ignorant action to a resulting state; I infer that momentary agitation leaves a durable social mark. Regret is not only emotion but belated residence on one's deed.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 49:9 reveals the maximum downstream cost of a wrongly aimed report: communal combat, not only private remorse. 49:12's separation of warranted indication from accusatory suspicion, and 49:18's exclusive reach into the hidden, further corrected verification into a discipline conscious of human epistemic limits.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Verification inserts separation between an arriving report and communal force.** `ج ي ء:B001` (whose variants cover coming and prevailing by repeated coming) makes the report’s arrival an event, and `ن ب ء:B002` marks it as consequential news capable of producing knowledge or strong probability. `ب ي ن:B004` supplies becoming clear, but the same inventory’s `ب ي ن:B001` supplies separation. The earlier ayat show voices pressing for immediate access, while 49:9–10 later make **بَيْنَهُمَا** the space of intervention between groups. The packet gives arrival, clarification, and relational separation; I infer that **فَتَبَيَّنُوٓا۟** creates an evidentiary interval so that arrival does not itself become authority. Verification thus reads as decoupling transmission from execution.

2. **The reporter is imaged as having slipped out of a containing skin.** The sole accepted branch for `ف س ق`, `ف س ق:B002`, is a fresh date emerging from its peel. Nearby chamber boundaries (49:4–5), the protective caution of 49:3 and 49:10, and the later pairing of **ٱلْفُسُوقَ** with unbelief and disobedience in 49:7 activate enclosure as the missing protection. The packet does not say that a report itself is peeled; I infer materially that the source has exited a norm-bearing cover, so what it carries cannot be treated as contained by communal trust (`ء م ن:B001`). **فَاسِقٌ بِنَبَإٍ** therefore identifies a transmission whose social casing has failed, not merely a person with a bad label.

3. **An action may hit its target and still miss correctness.** `ص و ب:B003` is aiming and actually hitting, whereas `ص و ب:B002` is correctness opposed to error; `ق و م:B001` makes the object a human group. The packet supplies both senses inside one root and then places the hit under `ج ه ل:B001`, lack of knowledge. I infer the crucial divergence: operational success against a group does not certify epistemic or moral correctness. **أَن تُصِيبُوا۟ قَوْمًا** consequently warns against effective but unjust action, a danger that 49:9’s regulated force and justice later answer.

4. **Ignorance is an agitated mode of action whose trace survives the moment.** Besides absence of knowledge (`ج ه ل:B001`), `ج ه ل:B002` supplies rash, unsettled folly and `ج ه ل:B005` agitation after stillness. The causal chain runs report, non-verified strike, a changed state (**تُصْبِحُوا۟**, `ص ب ح:B010`), and remorse (`ن د م:B001`); `ن د م:B003` additionally images a remaining trace. The packet gives the sequence but not this persistence claim; I infer that rashness converts a fleeting report into an enduring social and inward mark. The final clause therefore makes verification a temporal brake before an act becomes irreversible history.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: Ayat 49:12 and 49:18 add a second side to verification: one must neither act on weak suspicion nor invade the unseen to manufacture certainty. Clarification (`ب ي ن:B004`) is bounded by human access, while `غ ي ب:B001` remains divinely known; verification becomes disciplined sufficiency, not unlimited investigation.

baseline.text: Ey iman edenler! Yoldan çıkmış biri size bir haber getirirse doğruluğunu araştırın; yoksa bilmeden bir topluluğa zarar verir ve yaptığınızdan pişman olursunuz.

findings.text: Doğrulama, haberin gelişi ile topluluğa karşı güç kullanımı arasına kanıta dayalı bir mesafe koyar; ulaşmış olmak habere kendiliğinden yetki vermez.
Yoldan çıkan haberci için kabuğundan ayrılan meyve imgesi, taşıdığı haberin toplumsal güvence içinde geldiğinin varsayılamayacağını gösterir.
Hedefi fiilen vurmak, eylemin doğru olduğu anlamına gelmez; bilgisizce yürütülen operasyonel başarı ahlaki yanlışlık olabilir.
Anlık acelecilik, geçici bir hata olarak kalmayıp kişiyi kalıcı bir pişmanlık durumuna sokabilir ve toplumsal iz bırakabilir.
Doğrulama sınırsız gizli araştırma değildir; insan erişiminin sınırları içinde yeterli açıklık arayan bir disiplindir.
Haberin geliş doğrultusu ayrıca sınanmalıdır: kaynağından çıkmış olması, sesinin açık veya yönünün doğru olduğunu garanti etmez.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Reliable knowledge requires controlled passage from arrival or concealment to disclosure, examination, and accountable judgment.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Epistemic discipline is materialized as target practice, unmarked terrain, tactile probing, a dawn raid, and the cleaning of a well until what it holds becomes visible.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Unmarked Ground and Agitated Motion
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A traveler without landmarks loses orientation, becomes agitated, and moves before a route has been established.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: impulsive disturbance opposed to composure `quranic:root_000271:B002/m01`; unknown terrain without mark or prior use `quranic:root_000271:B003/m01`; agitation after stillness `quranic:root_000271:B005/m01`; road marker and appointed sign `quranic:root_000051:B005/m01`; traversing land without knowledge `quranic:root_000269:B009/m01`; landmark for orientation `quranic:root_001040:B002/m01`.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.ayah_anchors: ignorance occurs at 49:6; command/marker at 49:7 and 9; the public-voice root at 49:2; knowing/marking at 49:1, 7, 8, 13, 16, and 18.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Ignorance is not inert emptiness here. It is an unmarked setting that provokes restless motion: the traveler has neither prior knowledge nor a sign by which to orient. The scene explains why clarification must precede action, because agitation on unknown ground amplifies error rather than resolving it.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: The Report Becomes a Dawn Raid
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: An arriving report triggers a surprise approach at daybreak, turning unverified information into an attack on an unprepared group.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: dawn and first light `quranic:root_000839:B001/m01`; arrival in the morning `quranic:root_000839:B002/m01`; morning raid and distress call `quranic:root_000839:B004/m01`; coming upon people at dawn unawares `quranic:root_000269:B005/m01`; calamity striking its object `quranic:root_000889:B004/m01`.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.ayah_anchors: the morning/state root and the striking root occur at 49:6; the public-arrival root occurs at 49:2.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The latent scene supplies a concrete form for harming people in ignorance. News arrives, armed movement follows before full visibility, and an unsuspecting group receives the strike. Morning is therefore not a neutral time marker: it is the interval in which premature certainty becomes irreversible action.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Right relation consists in taking a governed direction: not moving ahead of the guide, accepting restraint, and returning after deviation.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Guidance is embodied as procession, measured travel, bridle, tether, city, and road geometry, so obedience appears as coordinated motion rather than passive immobility.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Command Within a Governed Polity
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A public affair is held by authority, issued as command, delegated for judgment, and maintained as an ordered social place.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: public affair or circumstance `quranic:root_000051:B001/m01`; binding command `quranic:root_000051:B002/m01`; authority and office `quranic:root_000051:B003/m01`; obedience as religion `quranic:root_000504:B001/m01`; city organized by obedience to authority `quranic:root_000504:B006/m01`; delegated judgment `quranic:root_000348:B005/m01`; governing care and maintenance `quranic:root_001273:B004/m01`; effective sovereign hand `quranic:root_001693:B005/m01`.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.ayah_anchors: affair, command, and authority occur at 49:7 and 9; wisdom/judgment at 49:8; people and governing care at 49:6 and 11; religion at 49:16; the hand root at 49:1.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Authority is not only a superior voice. It is an institutional scene with an affair to manage, command to issue, judgment to delegate, and community to maintain. The city image gives obedience a social architecture in which order depends on care as well as enforceable direction.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Right relation consists in taking a governed direction: not moving ahead of the guide, accepting restraint, and returning after deviation.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Guidance is embodied as procession, measured travel, bridle, tether, city, and road geometry, so obedience appears as coordinated motion rather than passive immobility.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Deviation, Overreach, and Return
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A party leaves the line, moves beyond its limit, and must be turned back to the governing course.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: resistance and deviation `quranic:root_001052:B001/m01`; moving aside `quranic:root_001052:B002/m01`; uncontrolled flow running sideways `quranic:root_001052:B003/m01`; departure from the straight line `quranic:root_000991:B006/m01`; injustice as deviation `quranic:root_001224:B002/m01`; overstepping in aggression `quranic:root_000138:B003/m01`; leaving group or obedience `quranic:root_000400:B006/m01`; ripe fruit breaking through its peel `quranic:root_001156:B002/m01`; disobedience `quranic:root_001022:B001/m01`; return `quranic:root_001191:B001/m01`.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.ayah_anchors: resistance occurs at 49:3 and 13; departure at 49:5; breach at 49:6, 7, and 11; disobedience at 49:7 and 11; deviation, aggression, and return at 49:9.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Aggression is represented as path error and boundary breach before it is treated as a fixed identity. Motion runs sideways, fruit breaks its containing peel, and a faction exits obedience. Because the failure is directional, return remains an available restorative operation.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Fractured relations are restored by stopping violence, rejoining separated parts, and setting the whole to a just line and measure.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Social repair takes material form as patching a vessel, draining a wound, setting a bone, hearing a grievance, balancing a load, and weaving kinship tissue.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Treating Wound, Relapse, and Fracture
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A wound is drained and filled, a broken bone is set, and the repair is guarded against renewed corruption.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: a wound filling and healing `quranic:root_001348:B008/m01`; setting a broken bone `quranic:root_000015:B002/m01`; refracturing a bone `quranic:root_001051:B004/m01`; relapse of a wound `quranic:root_001096:B004/m01`; wound swelling toward corruption `quranic:root_000138:B004/m01`; pus collected in a wound `quranic:root_000281:B006/m01`; abscess emerging from the body `quranic:root_000400:B004/m01`; wound reopening and leaving a trace `quranic:root_000289:B004/m01`.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.ayah_anchors: wound invalidation occurs at 49:2; setting at 49:3; abscess/emergence at 49:5; pus/arrival at 49:6; refracture at 49:7; wound corruption/aggression at 49:9; flesh at 49:12; relapse/covering at 49:3, 5, and 14.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The sequence separates initial closure from durable recovery. Pus and swelling must leave the interior, the fracture must be set, and relapse can still undo apparent healing. This materially pressures both reconciliation and the warning that a completed work can be nullified after it seemed secure.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Setting the Line and Balance
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A crooked or unequal arrangement is restrained, measured, counterweighted, and straightened.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: equivalence `quranic:root_000991:B002/m01`; counterbalanced load `quranic:root_000991:B004/m01`; straightening `quranic:root_000991:B005/m01`; allotted share `quranic:root_001224:B003/m01`; balance `quranic:root_001224:B004/m01`; crooked or stiff legs `quranic:root_001224:B005/m01`; restraint for correction `quranic:root_000348:B001/m01`; straightness `quranic:root_001273:B008/m01`; equal weight `quranic:root_001273:B015/m01`; wrong as placing a thing outside its proper time or place `quranic:root_000967:B004/m01`; withholding another's right `quranic:root_000967:B008/m01`.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.ayah_anchors: the cited evidence roots occur at 49:6, 8, 9, and 11.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Justice is the mechanical work of returning misplaced weight and withheld shares to proportion. An unequal load, a crooked support, and diverging parties are measured against a line. Restraint is justified by that reparative outcome: it must restore place and right rather than reproduce domination.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Human plurality is formed from one measured origin and becomes socially legible through faces, signs, group structure, and names.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The same social world can be born through one womb, assembled as fitted branches, made familiar through encounter, or damaged when mockery and hostile labels manufacture distance and reputation.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: One Origin Branches into Peoples
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A measured act of making produces male and female, then branches the resulting whole into facing and fitted groups.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: measuring before formation `quranic:root_000434:B001/m01`; creating `quranic:root_000434:B002/m01`; making or appointing `quranic:root_000248:B001/m01`; transforming into a social state `quranic:root_000248:B002/m01`; male `quranic:root_000516:B001/m01`; female `quranic:root_000058:B001/m01`; people as a social group `quranic:root_001273:B001/m01`; branching and separation `quranic:root_000797:B001/m01`; peoples as major branches `quranic:root_000797:B003/m01`; branch or offshoot `quranic:root_000797:B005/m01`; tribes facing one another `quranic:root_001198:B009/m01`; fitted facing parts `quranic:root_001198:B010/m01`.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.ayah_anchors: creation, sex, peoples, branches, and tribes occur at 49:13; the group root also occurs at 49:6 and 11.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Plurality is not presented as disconnected manufacture. A measured origin is transformed into differentiated groups whose branches still face and fit one another. Peoples and tribes are legible subdivisions of one made whole, which makes superiority by branch structurally incoherent.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: Value Made Visible in Gift, Work, and Cost
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Claims to worth become legible through accountable production, truthful enactment, transfer, and expenditure.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The channel distinguishes spoken claims from manufactured ones, and received favor from the laboring hands and spent capacity by which commitment becomes visible.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: A Claim Can Be Spoken or Manufactured
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A person articulates a claim, but circulation cannot show whether it reports an inward judgment truthfully or fabricates an attribution.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: articulate self-expression `quranic:root_000996:B001/m01`; spoken utterance `quranic:root_001272:B001/m01`; falsely attributing speech `quranic:root_001272:B005/m01`; unspoken inner saying `quranic:root_001272:B012/m01`; belief or opinion `quranic:root_001272:B013/m01`; invented speech `quranic:root_000434:B007/m01`; manufacturing a falsehood `quranic:root_001167:B004/m01`; truthful speech `quranic:root_000852:B001/m01`.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.ayah_anchors: self-expression occurs at 49:14; saying at 49:2, 14, 16, and 17; creating or inventing at 49:13; making or doing at 49:6; truth at 49:15 and 17.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Saying is only the visible event. Behind it may stand an inward judgment, while the same productive powers that make deeds can also manufacture speech and attach it falsely to another. The scene sharpens the surah's test of declarations: articulation is evidence that a claim exists, not yet that it is true.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadeleri bu dali yalniz korkunun kalkmasi olarak degil, kalbin yatismasi, guven verme, guvenilirlik, emanet edilen sey, guvenli yer ve dayanilir nitelik alanlariyla birlikte verir. Bu nedenle dalin cercevesi, guvenlik ve guvenilirlik ekseninde hem yalın hem de yapimli ve baglamli kullanislari ayirt ederek korunabilir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal inanma ya da dua cevabi degil; korkudan emin olma, guven verme ve guvenilir sayilma alanidir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalin guven ve korkusuzluk anlamlari ile belirli yapimli ya da soz obegi kullanislari birlikte vardir; tanim bunlari tek bir dar kaliba indirgemez.

concept_map.definition: Korkunun kalkmasiyla kalbin yatismasi, birine guven verilmesi veya bir kimsenin ya da seyin guvenilir kabul edilmesidir. Bu alan guvenli yer, emanet edilen sey, kendisine guvenilen kisi ve dayanilir binek gibi bagimli uygulamalari da kapsar.

facets.statement: Temel cekirdek korkuya karsi guven, ic yatiskinligi ve tehlikeden emin olma halidir.
Guven verme, birini kendi koruma ve teminat alani icine alma olarak kullanilir.
Guvenilirlik, ihanete karsi sadakat, emanet edilen sey ve kendisine guvenilen kisi anlamlarini dogurur.
Guvenin bulundugu yer, bir kimsenin emniyet icinde oldugu mesken veya siginak olarak adlandirilir.
Dayanikli ve aksamasindan korkulmayan deve kullanimi, guvenilirlik niteligini canli bir ornege uygular.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar ortak olarak bu dali korkunun ziddi olan guven, kalbin yatismasi ve guven verme alaninda toplar. Ayni iddia guvenilir kisi, emanet, guvenli yer ve dayanilir binek gibi turemis ya da baglamli kullanislari da cekirdege baglar.

concept_gloss.applicability: Korkunun kalkmasi, kalbin yatismasi, guven verme ve guvenilir sayilma alanlarini birlikte tasiyan en kisa genel karsiliktir.

error_profile.preserves: Hem guven halini hem de guvenilirlik ve emanet iliskisini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Korkunun giderilmesi ve ic yatiskinligi onde oldugunda dogal karsiliktir.

error_profile.preserves: Korku karsiti guven halini korur.
error_profile.loses: Emanet, guvenilirlik ve guven verme boyutlarini disarida birakir.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Birinin baskasini koruma ve teminat altina almasi anlatildiginda kullanilir.

error_profile.preserves: Bir baskasina guven saglama iliskisini korur.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadeleri bu dali acikca tasdik, haber ya da vaadi dogru sayma ve bazi dini kullanislarda hakka boyun egme olarak verir. Provisional cerceve guvene dokunan yanini not eder, fakat dal kimligi korkusuzluk degil tasdik ve kabul iliskisidir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal guvenlik hali degil; bir soz, haber, vaat veya hakikati dogru kabul etme alanidir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Hem genel tasdik adlari hem de belirli soz obekleri ve dini kullanislar vardir; tanim bunlari yalin guven anlamina genisletmez.

concept_map.definition: Bir haber, vaat veya hakikati dogru sayip ona icten kabul ile yonelmektir. Dini kullanista bu kabul, kalp, dil ve davranisla baglanan bir boyun egme ya da seriate girme anlami kazanabilir.

facets.statement: Temel cekirdek bir haberin, sozun veya hakikatin dogru sayilmasidir.
Hakka yonelik ic kabul, yalniz bilmekten ziyade boyun egme ve kabullenme bicimi alir.
Dini alanlarda bu kabul, bildirilen yola girme ve ona baglanma adi olarak kullanilir.
Ilahi sifat kullaniminda vaat edilen odulu dogrulama veya guvenceyle bildirme boyutu one cikar.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar dalin ortak cekirdegini tasdik olarak verir ve bir sozun dogru sayilmasini temsil eden ornegi buna baglar. Ayni iddia, daha ozel dini kullanimlarda hakka icten boyun egme, yola girme ve vaatle ilgili dogrulama boyutlarinin eklendigini de gosterir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Haber, vaat, hakikat ve dini baglanma kullanimlarini tasdik cekirdegi etrafinda birlestirir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadeleri bu dali dua icinde soylenen bir kabul istegi sozu ve bu sozu soyleme eylemi olarak verir. Cerceve, guven ve tasdik dallarindan ayrildigi ve sadece dua cevabi formuluyle ilgili oldugu icin uygundur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal guvenlik ya da tasdik degil; duada kabul talebini bildiren sabit sozdur.

lexicalization_scope.note: Dal belirli bir dua sozu ve onu soyleme eylemiyle sinirlidir; buradan genel guven ya da tasdik anlami cikarilmaz.

concept_map.definition: Dua sonunda kabul edilme istegini bildiren ve 'kabul et', 'oyle olsun' ya da 'bunu yap' anlaminda aciklanan sabit sozdur. Dal ayrica bu sozu soyleme eylemini ve kaynaklarda aktarılan ad yorumunu da kapsar.

facets.statement: Temel cekirdek, duada kabul istegini bildiren sabit cevap sozudur.
Kaynaklar sozun anlamini 'kabul et', 'oyle olsun' veya 'bunu yap' seklinde aciklar.
Bu sozu soyleme eylemi de ayni dal icinde adlandirilir.
Bazi aktarimlarda bu sozun ilahi bir ad oldugu yorumu da dalin yan rivayeti olarak bulunur.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar ortak olarak dali dua icinde soylenen ve kabul istegi tasiyan sabit bir soz olarak anlatir. Ayni iddia, bu sozu soyleme eylemini ve sozun anlamina dair 'kabul et' ya da 'oyle olsun' aciklamalarini da icerir; ad yorumu ise bu ortak malzemenin yan aktarimidir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, dalın merkezini itaatten ve Tanrı'nın buyruğundan çıkma; buyruğu bırakıp karşı gelmeye ve kötülüğe yönelme olarak kurar. Ahlaksızca davranma, günah işleme ve Tanrı'ya ortak koşma bu merkezin ağırlaşan gerçekleşmeleridir; anlam yalnızca inançsızlıkla sınırlı değildir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal, fiziksel bir kabuktan çıkışı ya da fareye verilen özel adı değil, buyruk ve itaat sınırının davranışsal olarak aşılmasını anlatır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, ad ve eylem biçimlerindeki genel itaatten çıkma çekirdeğini, Tanrı'nın buyruğuna karşı gelme gibi belirtilmiş yapılardan ayırır; yapıya bağlı ifadeler bütün dala tek başına genellenmez.

concept_map.definition: Bağlayıcı buyruğa ve itaate bağlı kalma sınırından çıkıp buyruğu bırakma, ona karşı gelme ve kötülüğe yönelme durumudur. Ahlaksızca davranma, günah işleme ve Tanrı'ya ortak koşmaya kadar uzanabilir; kapsamı salt inançsızlıktan daha geniştir.

facets.statement: Bağlayıcı bir buyruğa ve itaate bağlı kalma sınırından çıkma durumudur.
Tanrı'nın buyruğunu bırakma, ona karşı gelme ve kötülüğe yönelme biçiminde gerçekleşebilir.
Kapsamı ahlaksızca davranmayı, günah işlemeyi ve Tanrı'ya ortak koşmayı içerebilir; yalnızca inançsızlıkla sınırlı değildir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak anlatımı, itaat ve buyruk sınırından çıkmayı temel alır. Buyruğu bırakma ve karşı gelmeye yönelme bu çekirdeği açar; kötülük, günah ve Tanrı'ya ortak koşma kapsam içindeki gerçekleşmelerdir ve dal salt inançsızlıktan daha geniş tutulur.

concept_gloss.text: itaatten çıkıp Tanrı'nın buyruğuna karşı gelme ve kötülüğe yönelme

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi tutarlı biçimde taze hurma tanesinin kabuğundan dışarı çıkmasını bildirir. Bu fiziksel olay, genel bir çıkma anlamı olarak değil, meyve ile kendi kabuğunu birlikte belirten sınırlı söz dizimi içinde tanımlanmalıdır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesinin değişmez çekirdeği, küçültmeli bir kötüleme adının fareyi belirtmesidir. identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, bir yerden başka bir yere gelme, çıkma veya geçme çekirdeğini açıkça kurar; bir topluluğun karşısına çıkma ve toprağın bir şeyi ortaya getirmesi bu hareket tasarımının özel gerçekleşmeleridir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal haber verme, hafif ses ve kutsal elçilik anlamlarını değil, yer değiştirme ile belirme kullanımlarını kapsar.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, bağımsız hareket biçimleriyle toprağın bir şeyi ortaya getirmesini anlatan sınırlı kullanımı birbirinden ayırır.

concept_map.definition: Bir varlığın bulunduğu yerden başka bir yere gelmesi, çıkması veya geçmesi ve böylece yeni yerde belirmesidir. Toprağın bir şeyi getirip ortaya çıkarması da bu çekirdeğe bağlı özel bir kullanımdır.

Toprak, bir şeyi bulunduğu yerde getirip ortaya çıkarmış sayılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar yerler arası geçiş çekirdeğinde birleşir; insan, hayvan ve taşkın su gibi hareket eden varlıkların yanı sıra bir topluluğun karşısına çıkma ve toprağın bir şeyi ortaya getirmesi de anılır.

concept_map.definition: Bir olay veya durum hakkında iletilen haber, özellikle bilgi ya da güçlü bir kanaat sağlayacak ölçüde önemli haber anlamıdır. Birine haber vermek, belirli bir şeyi bildirmek ve birinden haber istemek bu çekirdeğe bağlı eylemlerdir.

facets.statement: Bir olay veya durum hakkında başkasına ulaşan bilgi içerikli haber söz konusudur.

Haber verme, bir şeyi bildirme ve karşı taraftan haber isteme eylemleri aynı çekirdeğe bağlanır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi istenen yere ulaştıran açık yolu temel anlam olarak verir ve ayrıca belirli bir kullanımda arazinin kolay geçilen bölümünü anarak iki unsuru aynı dal içinde açıkça destekler.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal kutsal elçiyi, haberi veya sesi değil, yönü belli açık yolu ve buna bağlı kolay geçilen arazi kullanımını kapsar.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım bağımsız yol anlamını merkeze alır; kolay araziyi kaynakta belirtilen bağlı kullanım olarak ayrı bir uzantıda tutar.

concept_map.definition: İnsanı gitmek istediği yere ulaştıran açık ve izlenebilir yoldur. Belirli bir arazi anlatımında kolay geçilen düz yer de buna bağlı olarak adlandırılır.

facets.statement: Yol açıkça seçilir ve izleyeni gitmek istediği yere ulaştırır.
Belirli bir arazi kullanımında kolay geçilen düz bölüm de aynı adla anılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tek kaynak açık yolun kişiyi istediği yere ulaştırdığını belirtir ve aynı toplu kayıtta belirli bir arazi parçasının kolay geçilen bölümünü de bu adla anar.

concept_gloss.applicability: Yolun hem görünür ve izlenebilir oluşunu hem de hedefe ulaştırma işlevini karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Açıkça seçilen yol ile istenen hedefe ulaştırma işlevini birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Belirli bir arazi içinde ilerlemeye elverişli ve kolay geçilen bölüm anlatıldığında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Arazi parçasının düzlüğünü ve kolay geçilebilir oluşunu korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: istenen yere götüren açık yol; kolay geçilen düz yer

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu dal yolu yöntem ve açıklık kavramlarına genişletir; odak dal hedefe götüren somut yol ve kolay geçilen araziyle sınırlıdır.

neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Yolun düz, koruyucu ve izinin kesintisiz olması ayrıca zorunlu niteliklerdir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal açık, izlenebilir ve yolcuyu yönlendiren somut yolu anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu dal doğruluk ile izin kesintisizliğini öne çıkarır; odak dal açıklık ve istenen yere ulaştırma işlevini öne çıkarır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Yolun insanı istediği yere ulaştırması ve düz arazi kullanımı belirtilir.

neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal açıkça fark edilen ve takip edilebilen somut yol anlamını paylaşır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu dal darlık ve hayvan izleriyle belirlenen yolu kapsar; odak dal genişlik belirtmeden yolun hedefe ulaştırmasına dayanır.
